what_happened: Compiled probes against the real CSLib definitions on the fork's own toolchain (lake env lean on a scratchpad file, no .lean written in either tree) confirmed the LAR carrier is a Fintype by inferInstance once Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Perm is imported, that the explicit-data form discharges the existential proof_wanted in one term, and that the chain-indexed Rabin pairs need no Decidable instance. Cost estimate rests on measurement rather than recall.

The cost estimate on record (the fork's own docstring at DA/Conversions.lean:96-111) names a construction -- 'enumerate all accepting sets as Rabin pairs', same state space, 2^|Q| pairs -- that is not merely incomplete but unsound (already refuted by the archived Muller-sufficiency report's two-state example). The actual construction needs a |Q|!*|Q| state-space blowup, so the estimate on record understates both the state space and the proof work.

Guardrail (f) fires partially: the corpus holds the construction (Thomas 1997 Theorem 6.5, full state set / initial state / transitions / acceptance chain) but NOT the proof of its key invariant (Remark 6.6, stated with 'one verifies the following claim'). The single hardest Lean obligation is precisely the step the corpus leaves unproved.

Plan phase found the research report already discharged all four dispatch deliverables, so planning reduced to closing the two evidence gaps the report itself named; both were confirmed resolvable at plan time (Reynolds 2001 K4B located by grep in three held chunks; Thomas 1997 PDF present), so no needs_research round was owed.

Research Recommendation 1 asks that specs/archive/879's row 16 Safra/Piterman misattribution be corrected, but git check-ignore shows .gitignore:94 ignores specs/archive/, so an edit there is not a durable record. The correction was sited in this task's own report instead and the archived edit recorded as a non-goal.

Phase 1 de-carry succeeded fully and cheaply: all three carried sub-claims of Finding 1.4 (bl signature shape, K as accepting-pair count, K4B recency ordering) were confirmed first-hand in the held Reynolds 2001 chunks within four reads, and a carried wording error was caught (the phrase 'order of Vps ceasing to appear' is s11's motivating remark, not K4B's own text). The CARRIED-UNVERIFIED marker was retired rather than merely restated.

Phase 2 page-image check found Finding 1.3's claim that 'nothing in either is tree-specific' was too strong: Thomas 1997's transition rule is written with two successor components, one per tree direction. Corrected in place; the finding's conclusion (transposition is a restriction, not a generalization) survives. The check also surfaced a proper-chain pruning step omitted from Finding 1.2, and strengthened the rigour gap (the final equivalence step is also asserted as 'easy to check', not proved).
